narrative_summary: SPX closed at 7,572.40, pressing right back into the 6/15 swing high (7,578) that has repeatedly capped this multi-week recovery, with a benign sub-16 VIX and a Monte Carlo edge that has surged to a 79.8% up-first probability clearing all regime thresholds. Yet the structural regime remains Late Bull / Topping: ERP is pinned at 0.39% (valuation ceiling), forward PE is 20.25x, and McClellan breadth sits near its lows with net new highs still weak, so price strength is not confirmed by internals. The primary tension is a mechanically intact, momentum-strong bull skeleton grinding into hard, repeatedly-rejected resistance against late-cycle valuation and breadth divergence. Posture stays trim bias into strength — the strong Monte Carlo edge justifies patience over defense, but not aggressive adds at a valuation ceiling and unconfirmed breakout.
